title: Ana's Birthday
text:
My name is Ana. My birthday is in May. It is on the fifth of May. My family has a party every year.

June is my favorite month. In June, school ends. We go to the beach with my friends. It is hot and sunny.

questions.text: How does Ana probably feel about June?
Why do Ana and her friends probably go to the beach in June?

vocabulary.definition: the day each year when you celebrate the day you were born
a sandy place next to the sea
an event where people meet to celebrate something

paragraph_translations: Me llamo Ana. Mi cumpleaños es en mayo. Es el cinco de mayo. Mi familia hace una fiesta cada año.
Junio es mi mes favorito. En junio terminan las clases. Vamos a la playa con mis amigos. Hace calor y el día está soleado.
